verses.en: Go to now, ye rich men, weep and howl for your miseries that shall come upon you.
verses.pt: Eia agora, vós ricos, chorai e pranteai, por causa das desgraças que vos sobrevirão.
verses.en_web: Come now, you rich, weep and howl for your miseries that are coming on you.
verses.en_bbe: Come now, you men of wealth, give yourselves to weeping and crying because of the bitter troubles which are coming to you.

verses.en: Your riches are corrupted, and your garments are motheaten.
verses.pt: As vossas riquezas estão apodrecidas, e as vossas vestes estão roídas pela traça.
verses.en_web: Your riches are corrupted and your garments are moth-eaten.
verses.en_bbe: Your wealth is unclean and insects have made holes in your clothing.

verses.en: Your gold and silver is cankered; and the rust of them shall be a witness against you, and shall eat your flesh as it were fire. Ye have heaped treasure together for the last days.
verses.pt: O vosso ouro e a vossa prata estão enferrujados; e a sua ferrugem dará testemunho contra vós, e devorará as vossas carnes como fogo. Entesourastes para os últimos dias.
verses.en_web: Your gold and your silver are corroded, and their corrosion will be for a testimony against you, and will eat your flesh like fire. You have laid up your treasure in the last days.
verses.en_bbe: Your gold and your silver are wasted and their waste will be a witness against you, burning into your flesh. You have put by your store in the last days.

verses.en: Behold, the hire of the labourers who have reaped down your fields, which is of you kept back by fraud, crieth: and the cries of them which have reaped are entered into the ears of the Lord of sabaoth.
verses.pt: Eis que o salário que fraudulentamente retivestes aos trabalhadores que ceifaram os vossos campos clama, e os clamores dos ceifeiros têm chegado aos ouvidos do Senhor dos exércitos.
verses.en_web: Behold, the wages of the laborers who mowed your fields, which you have kept back by fraud, cry out, and the cries of those who reaped have entered into the ears of the Lord of Armies.
verses.en_bbe: See, the money which you falsely kept back from the workers cutting the grass in your field, is crying out against you; and the cries of those who took in your grain have come to the ears of the Lord of armies.

verses.en: Ye have lived in pleasure on the earth, and been wanton; ye have nourished your hearts, as in a day of slaughter.
verses.pt: Deliciosamente vivestes sobre a terra, e vos deleitastes; cevastes os vossos corações no dia da matança.
verses.en_web: You have lived in luxury on the earth, and taken your pleasure. You have nourished your hearts as in a day of slaughter.
verses.en_bbe: You have been living delicately on earth and have taken your pleasure; you have made your hearts fat for a day of destruction.

verses.en: Ye have condemned and killed the just; and he doth not resist you.
verses.pt: Condenastes e matastes o justo; ele não vos resiste.
verses.en_web: You have condemned, you have murdered the righteous one. He doesn’t resist you.
verses.en_bbe: You have given your decision against the upright man and have put him to death. He puts up no fight against you.

verses.en: Be patient therefore, brethren, unto the coming of the Lord. Behold, the husbandman waiteth for the precious fruit of the earth, and hath long patience for it, until he receive the early and latter rain.
verses.pt: Portanto, irmãos, sede pacientes até a vinda do Senhor. Eis que o lavrador espera o precioso fruto da terra, aguardando-o com paciência, até que receba as primeiras e as últimas chuvas.
verses.en_web: Be patient therefore, brothers, until the coming of the Lord. Behold, the farmer waits for the precious fruit of the earth, being patient over it, until it receives the early and late rain.
verses.en_bbe: Go on waiting calmly, my brothers, till the coming of the Lord, like the farmer waiting for the good fruit of the earth till the early and late rains have come.

verses.en: Be ye also patient; stablish your hearts: for the coming of the Lord draweth nigh.
verses.pt: Sede vós também pacientes; fortalecei os vossos corações, porque a vinda do Senhor está próxima.
verses.en_web: You also be patient. Establish your hearts, for the coming of the Lord is at hand.
verses.en_bbe: Be as calm in your waiting; let your hearts be strong: because the coming of the Lord is near.

verses.en: Grudge not one against another, brethren, lest ye be condemned: behold, the judge standeth before the door.
verses.pt: Não vos queixeis, irmãos, uns dos outros, para que não sejais julgados. Eis que o juiz está à porta.
verses.en_web: Don’t grumble, brothers, against one another, so that you won’t be judged. Behold, the judge stands at the door.
verses.en_bbe: Say no hard things against one another, brothers, so that you will not be judged; see, the judge is waiting at the doors.

verses.en: Take, my brethren, the prophets, who have spoken in the name of the Lord, for an example of suffering affliction, and of patience.
verses.pt: Irmãos, tomai como exemplo de sofrimento e paciência os profetas que falaram em nome do Senhor.
verses.en_web: Take, brothers, for an example of suffering and of perseverance, the prophets who spoke in the name of the Lord.
verses.en_bbe: Take as an example of pain nobly undergone and of strength in trouble, the prophets who gave to men the words of the Lord.

verses.en: Behold, we count them happy which endure. Ye have heard of the patience of Job, and have seen the end of the Lord; that the Lord is very pitiful, and of tender mercy.
verses.pt: Eis que chamamos bem-aventurados os que suportaram aflições. Ouvistes da paciência de Jó, e vistes o fim que o Senhor lhe deu, porque o Senhor é cheio de misericórdia e compaixão.
verses.en_web: Behold, we call them blessed who endured. You have heard of the perseverance of Job, and have seen the Lord in the outcome, and how the Lord is full of compassion and mercy.
verses.en_bbe: We say that those men who have gone through pain are happy: you have the story of Job and the troubles through which he went and have seen that the Lord was full of pity and mercy in the end.

verses.en: But above all things, my brethren, swear not, neither by heaven, neither by the earth, neither by any other oath: but let your yea be yea; and your nay, nay; lest ye fall into condemnation.
verses.pt: Mas, sobretudo, meus irmãos, não jureis, nem pelo céu, nem pela terra, nem façais qualquer outro juramento; seja, porém, o vosso sim, sim, e o vosso não, não, para não cairdes em condenação.
verses.en_web: But above all things, my brothers, don’t swear— not by heaven, or by the earth, or by any other oath; but let your “yes” be “yes”, and your “no”, “no”; so that you don’t fall into hypocrisy.
verses.en_bbe: But most of all, my brothers, do not take oaths, not by the heaven, or by the earth, or by any other thing: but let your Yes be Yes, and your No be No: so that you may not be judged.

verses.en: Is any among you afflicted? let him pray. Is any merry? let him sing psalms.
verses.pt: Está aflito alguém entre vós? Ore. Está alguém contente? Cante louvores.
verses.en_web: Is any among you suffering? Let him pray. Is any cheerful? Let him sing praises.
verses.en_bbe: Is anyone among you in trouble? let him say prayers. Is anyone glad? let him make a song of praise.

verses.en: Is any sick among you? let him call for the elders of the church; and let them pray over him, anointing him with oil in the name of the Lord:
verses.pt: Está doente algum de vós? Chame os anciãos da igreja, e estes orem sobre ele, ungido-o com óleo em nome do Senhor;
verses.en_web: Is any among you sick? Let him call for the elders of the assembly, and let them pray over him, anointing him with oil in the name of the Lord,
verses.en_bbe: Is anyone among you ill? let him send for the rulers of the church; and let them say prayers over him, putting oil on him in the name of the Lord.

verses.en: And the prayer of faith shall save the sick, and the Lord shall raise him up; and if he have committed sins, they shall be forgiven him.
verses.pt: e a oração da fé salvará o doente, e o Senhor o levantará; e, se houver cometido pecados, ser-lhe-ão perdoados.
verses.en_web: and the prayer of faith will heal him who is sick, and the Lord will raise him up. If he has committed sins, he will be forgiven.
verses.en_bbe: And by the prayer of faith the man who is ill will be made well, and he will be lifted up by the Lord, and for any sin which he has done he will have forgiveness.

verses.en: Confess your faults one to another, and pray one for another, that ye may be healed. The effectual fervent prayer of a righteous man availeth much.
verses.pt: Confessai, portanto, os vossos pecados uns aos outros, e orai uns pelos outros, para serdes curados. A súplica de um justo pode muito na sua atuação.
verses.en_web: Confess your offenses to one another, and pray for one another, that you may be healed. The insistent prayer of a righteous person is powerfully effective.
verses.en_bbe: So then, make a statement of your sins to one another, and say prayers for one another so that you may be made well. The prayer of a good man is full of power in its working.

verses.en: Elias was a man subject to like passions as we are, and he prayed earnestly that it might not rain: and it rained not on the earth by the space of three years and six months.
verses.pt: Elias era homem sujeito às mesmas paixões que nós, e orou com fervor para que não chovesse, e por três anos e seis meses não choveu sobre a terra.
verses.en_web: Elijah was a man with a nature like ours, and he prayed earnestly that it might not rain, and it didn’t rain on the earth for three years and six months.
verses.en_bbe: Elijah was a man of flesh and blood as we are, and he made a strong prayer that there might be no rain; and there was no rain on the earth for three years and six months.

verses.en: And he prayed again, and the heaven gave rain, and the earth brought forth her fruit.
verses.pt: E orou outra vez e o céu deu chuva, e a terra produziu o seu fruto.
verses.en_web: He prayed again, and the sky gave rain, and the earth produced its fruit.
verses.en_bbe: And he made another prayer, and the heaven sent down rain and the earth gave her fruit.

verses.en: Brethren, if any of you do err from the truth, and one convert him;
verses.pt: Meus irmãos, se alguém dentre vós se desviar da verdade e alguém o converter,
verses.en_web: Brothers, if any among you wanders from the truth and someone turns him back,
verses.en_bbe: My brothers, if one of you has gone out of the way of the true faith and another has made him see his error,

verses.en: Let him know, that he which converteth the sinner from the error of his way shall save a soul from death, and shall hide a multitude of sins.
verses.pt: sabei que aquele que fizer converter um pecador do erro do seu caminho salvará da morte uma alma, e cobrirá uma multidão de pecados.
verses.en_web: let him know that he who turns a sinner from the error of his way will save a soul from death and will cover a multitude of sins.
verses.en_bbe: Be certain that he through whom a sinner has been turned from the error of his way, keeps a soul from death and is the cause of forgiveness for sins without number.
